name: imap-slim
description: Read, search, flag and draft email over IMAP. Drafts only - nothing is ever sent.
long_description: Connects Claude to your mailboxes. Claude can list, read and search mail, flag messages, save attachments and write drafts (including replies that quote the original). It never sends mail: drafts land in your Drafts folder for you to review and send from your mail program. Mailboxes are added and removed in a panel inside the chat - ask Claude to manage mailboxes; passwords go to the system keychain, not to Claude. Does not work with Outlook.com or Microsoft 365: they no longer allow password login for IMAP.

tools.name: use_mail
tools.description: List, read, search and flag mail, save attachments, and create or replace drafts.

tools.name: manage_mailboxes
tools.description: Open the panel to add, change or remove mailboxes.
